name: Thermal Comfort in Sight
description: Pairwise street view comparison of thermal affordance (VATA) and 19 visual-perceptual indicators from Yang et al. (2025): 18 comparisons per indicator, TrueSkill repeated 20 times and normalised to 0–5.
author: Yang et al.

pages.name: page_1760605955437
pages.title: Part 1: Visual Assessment of Thermal Affordance

elements.name: thermal_comfort_intro
elements.title: Visual Assessment of Thermal Affordance (VATA). Choose the image in each pair.
elements.description: The first comparison is outdoor thermal comfort. The next one asks which place feels comfortable overall, and is not part of the original VATA item.

elements.name: thermal_comfort
elements.title: Which street view image do you perceive as having a more comfortable outdoor thermal environment for you?
elements.description: choose the most thermal (heat) -comfortable one.

elements.name: comfort
elements.title: Which street view image do you perceive as a more comfortable place overall?
elements.description: Overall comfort, not heat alone. Choose the more comfortable place. This comparison is an optional extension and is not one of the original study indicators.

pages.description: First compare outdoor thermal comfort. Then compare which place feels comfortable overall; that second comparison is not part of the original study.

pages.title: Part 3: Streetscape Environment Perception

elements.name: environment_intro
elements.title: Microclimate inference and environmental evaluation. Choose the image in each pair.

elements.name: artificial_heat_sources
elements.title: Which street view image do you perceive as showing more artificial heat sources, such as buildings and cars?

elements.name: greenery

elements.name: shading_area
elements.title: Which street view image do you think showcases more shading areas?

elements.name: construction_material_comfort
elements.title: Which street view image do you think showcases higher construction material comfort?
elements.description: choose the one with most comfortable construction material (plant, wall, fence, window...).

pages.description: Please choose the image in which you think to exhibit the following environmental parameters most, there are nine parameters in this section.

config.title: Urban Streetscape Perception Survey
config.description: Hello! Here at the Urban Analytics Lab at the National University of Singapore, we are currently conducting an online perception survey that will take approximately 15 minutes to complete and consists of around 50 questions regarding photos taken at the street-level. Such a survey will help us understand what drives people’s perception and how to design spaces that are visually appealing. Throughout the survey, participants’ main task is to select the most suitable street view image among multiple images based on certain dimensions and personal impressions. As a token of appreciation, participants who successfully complete the full survey will receive a compensation fee of SGD 5.
